bumpRationale: Patch: portfolio-standard audit (jospabloh/acacia-app-standard, module 4) found 20 of 32 entities in base44/entities/*.jsonc missing the service-role admin branch ({"user_condition":{"role":"admin"}}) on all four RLS ops — AbsenceNotification, ChargeItem, Classroom, DiaryEntry, Discount, EmergencyContact, Event, EventResponse, Homework, Notice, NoticeDelivery, OfficialDocument, ParentProfile, ParentStudent, PaymentConcept, PermissionOverride, SchoolSetupGuide, TeacherClassroom, UniformOrder, WeeklyMenu. Those entities gated admin access only via the custom data.app_role field, which asServiceRole (role:admin, no end-user context) can never match — any future backend function reading/writing one of them via the service role would silently see zero rows or have its write rejected, the same class of bug documented for base44/functions/governRoleChange's own entities (UserProfile/PendingChange) before those were fixed. Fixed additively: each affected op's original rule is now one branch of a new outer $or alongside the admin branch — nothing narrowed, nothing removed. scripts/validate-rls.mjs doesn't check for this class by design (see its own header comment) so it didn't and won't catch a future regression here; adding that check is a natural follow-up, not done in this release. No entity schema field, permission, or tenant-isolation *rule* changed — only the missing service-role OR-branch was added. 276/276 tests pass (none exercise entity RLS directly, so this change is not covered by the existing suite — verified instead via scripts/validate-rls.mjs, which passes clean at 32 entities); lint clean; build succeeds.

architecture.runtime: browser (client-side only; no application server) + Base44 backend functions for privileged mutations
architecture.enforcementBoundary: base44 Row-Level Security (entity + field-level RLS) in base44/entities/*.jsonc + service-role backend functions in base44/functions/*
architecture.language: JavaScript / JSX (type-checked via jsconfig); Deno TypeScript for backend functions

assistantSkills.note: The sibling claude-skills repo holds 48 generic Anthropic/Claude authoring skills (pdf, xlsx, brainstorming, math-olympiad, ...). They are assistant tooling used to BUILD Liuma — NOT features of the application, not integrated into it, and not listed in the user manual.
